name: Brazilian Legal Precedents
shortDescription: Provides automated access to Brazilian legal precedents from the Supreme Federal Court, Superior Court of Justice, and Superior Labor Court using web scraping to handle dynamic content and authentication for legal research and case law analysis.

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server for agent-based research on Brazilian law using official sources, built by Pedro Roque de Mattia with web scraping capabilities powered by Patchright (Playwright fork) and Selenium. The implementation provides structured access to legal precedents from Brazil's highest courts including the Supreme Federal Court (STF), Superior Court of Justice (STJ), and Superior Labor Court (TST) through automated browser interactions that handle dynamic content, authentication flows, and anti-bot measures. Designed for legal professionals, researchers, and AI assistants requiring programmatic access to Brazilian jurisprudence for case law analysis, legal research workflows, and precedent discovery tasks where official court databases need to be queried systematically.
